snippet.title: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Your Mission: Eliminate Your Mentor.

METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER will be released on August 28, 2025! Pre-Order Now: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/metal-gear-solid-d-snake-eater/9NX56N49H8V0/0017

METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER is a remake of the 2004 game METAL GEAR SOLID 3: SNAKE EATER.

The remake maintains what players loved from the original, like the story, characters, voice acting, gameplay, and music, but presented now in an even more immersive experience.
